name: Account created
subject: Your SisTemplate account is ready
body:
Hello {name},

Your SisTemplate account has been created and is ready to use. You can now sign in with the username below.

Username: {username}

For your security, you'll be asked to verify a one-time code the first time you sign in. If you did not expect this email, please contact your administrator.

name: Internal password reset
subject: Reset Password – SisTemplate
body:
Dear Sir/Madam, {name},

We have received a request to reset the password for your SisTemplate account. Please use the secure link below. This link is valid for {expiryHours} hours:

{resetUrl}

If you did not request this password reset, please ignore this email — your account remains secure. Please do not share this link. If you need assistance, contact {contact}.

Thank you,
SisTemplate — Notification System

—

Yth. Bapak/Ibu, {name},

Kami menerima permintaan untuk mereset password akun Anda di SisTemplate. Silakan gunakan tautan aman berikut. Tautan ini berlaku selama {expiryHours} jam:

{resetUrl}

Jika Anda tidak merasa meminta reset password, mohon abaikan email ini — akun Anda tetap aman. Mohon tidak membagikan tautan ini. Apabila membutuhkan bantuan, hubungi {contact}.

Terima kasih,
SisTemplate — Sistem Notifikasi
